description: Cited research answer. Send one question; returns a 120 to 300 word answer with numbered [n] citations and the source URLs read, each with the time it was read. Searches the web, or reads only the urls you pass. Suited to an agent that needs a sourced answer it can show a person. Not for raw result lists or pages behind logins. Typical response 5 to 12 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

max_sources.description: How many sources to read, 1 to 8.

urls.description: Optional pages to answer from instead of searching.

name: quantagentshop_research_answer
title: Research answer
